messages:
maya: Heads-up — deploy-bot just paused the payments-service promotion in eu-west. It reports a values-override ordering conflict and the canary got the old DB host. Can someone take a look?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Promotion paused for payments-service: canary-failure (values-override-ordering). Details: overlay application order changed vs promoted chart. See /deploy/logs/3498765432.

sam: On it. Tracing the canary logs now — it pulled the new image but applied base values after the env overlay, so FEATURE_X=false in prod pods. Looks like the overlay ordering in the chart was reordered in the latest chart bump.

anya: Confirmed locally — the new chart charts/payments v1.5.0 added an overlay that sorts maps differently, which breaks our assumption in values. Feature flag keys end up overwritten.

josh: Two possible paths: 1) pin the chart back to last known-good version and re-run the promotion, or 2) hotpatch chart to restore previous overlay order and promote. Which has lower blast radius?

sam: No DB migrations, so pinning is lowest risk. We can re-promote 1.4.2 quickly.

maya: What's the exact helm command to do a manual pin promotion so deploy-bot doesn't auto-skip?

josh: Use manual promotion with explicit --version. Example:

helm upgrade --install payments-service charts/payments --version 1.4.2 -f values-prod.yaml --set image.tag=sha-abc123 --namespace prod

josh: Also add --reuse-values only if you want to keep runtime overrides. I wouldn't in this hotfix.

release-manager: Reminder: we're inside the eu-west change window (02:00-04:00). If customers are impacted we can proceed, otherwise schedule for 08:00. Any telemetry on user-facing errors?

maya: Yes customers saw 502s intermittently — I'm +1 to pin now. We should keep the window open and monitor for 30m after promotion.

anya: I'll open a tiny PR to revert the overlay change and add a unit test that asserts overlay ordering for critical path keys. After pin promotion we can merge the fix and re-promote the fixed chart.

sam: I'll run the manual pin now and watch canary. Triggering: /deploy promote payments-service --version 1.4.2 --manual

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual promotion command received by sam. Initiating canary with chart v1.4.2. Canary pods starting...

sam: Canary looks healthy after 2 minutes. No feature flags reverted and no 502s in the canary logs.

josh: OK, proceed to full rollout. I'm updating release notes: "Hotfix: revert chart overlay ordering causing values to be applied out-of-order; pinned to v1.4.2 during incident."

release-manager: Add a postmortem blurb and link to PR. Also add a rollback playbook entry: how to pin chart and who to notify.

maya: Thanks all. anya — ping when PR is ready so we can schedule a follow-up promotion to v1.5.0 once tests and CI are green. :thumbsup:

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/payments/pull/987 — includes unit test and changelog. I also added a CI job that diffs overlay application order.

sam: Runbook note added: https://confluence.redwood.io/runbooks/deploy-pin-playbook — includes helm commands and deploy-bot flags.

maya: Closing thread once the follow-up promotion is scheduled. Good catch by the canary checks.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Promotion completed and full rollout succeeded for payments-service (v1.4.2). Metric monitor: no error-rate spike in last 10m.
